metadata.description: Parrot Council Protocol (PCP): the two PCP plugins for Claude, fetched from their own repositories. Proprietary; supplied under license only. Access to those repositories is required.

plugins.name: pcp
plugins.description: Adversarial Claim Review as skills, subagents and the pinned method text. Text only; nothing enforces it.

plugins.name: pcp-os
plugins.description: Adversarial Claim Review over the native core of PCP OS: a register whose guards run outside the assistant's context, module workspaces, a task view and host hooks. Install this or pcp, not both.
